documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Meeting Of Executive Committee Of The Board Of Bhagyanagar India Limited Held On 13.08.2026 - Preferential Allotment Of Equity Shares
In-Principle Approval Under Regulation 28(1) Of SEBI ( LODR) Regulations, 2015
Corrigendum To Extra-Ordinary General Meeting ("EGM") Notice, Dated 30.06.2026
Submission Of Voting Results Along With Scrutinizer Report

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported a turnover of over 700 crores for Q1 FY27, with sales volumes of 5,278 tons and an EBITDA margin of 5.43%. Management noted that volume was temporarily impacted in the first two months due to trade route disruptions, but June volumes recovered strongly to 2,200 tons. The company is proceeding with corporate restructuring to form Tieramet Limited for its copper business while retaining land and windmill assets in Bhagyanagar India. Management projects overall volume growth of 12% to 15% for the year and a targeted capex of 40 crores over FY27 and FY28. Bhagyanagar India Limited released its Q1FY27 investor presentation highlighting financial performance, corporate restructuring via a composite scheme of arrangement, and a preferential equity issue of Rs.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth of 12% to 15% for the full year.
guidance.quote: So, | think we should be looking at between 12% to 15% growth in terms of volume for the whole year now.

guidance.claim: The company guides to maintain its EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5% for the rest of the year.
guidance.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

guidance.claim: Management estimates export contribution to be between 12% and 15% for the year.
guidance.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

guidance.claim: Management is confident of achieving 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30.
guidance.quote: So, see, the copper prices are out of our control. At 15% volume growth, you can do the reverse math based on the copper prices to see when we achieve it. But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: Management targets 5,000 crores in revenue in the year 2030.
guidance.quote: Our top line projection, as in earlier, this thing, has been project... we are aiming for 3,000 crores in the year 2030. That is, in 3 years, we are planning to reach 5,000 crores in the year 2030.

guidance.claim: The company targets a 25% CAGR for the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: Management expects volume growth of 20% minimum every year.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices. Between 15% to 20% should be our volume growth minimum every year.

guidance.claim: Management is hopeful of maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

demand_outlook.claim: India is projected to consume around 2.4 million metric tons of copper by 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: As we can see, India is actually one of the fastest growing copper users in the world, with around 2.4 million metric tons projected to be consumed in India by 2030.

demand_outlook.claim: Secondary copper demand in India is expected to double in the next 5 years from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.
demand_outlook.quote: Out of this, if you look at the secondary copper demand, it is expected to double in the next 5 years, from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.

demand_outlook.claim: The recycled copper market in India is estimated to grow at a CAGR of about 12-13%.
demand_outlook.quote: The recycled copper market, by some estimates, should be growing in India at a CAGR of about 12-13%.

demand_outlook.claim: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.
demand_outlook.quote: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in copper consumption will be driven by EV and automotive, power and electrification, and renewable energy.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth will mainly be driven by three sectors, EV and automotive. Because, EV requires a lot more copper than regular cars, power and electrification is also a big growth factor, and renewable energy.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects a big shortage of copper coming after 3 or 4 years.
demand_outlook.quote: The availability, while right now there is no shortage for the next 2 or 3 years for copper. But we foresee a big shortage coming after 3 or 4 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has finished adding its capacity of 35,000 metric tons which is now online.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

capex_expansion.claim: Management has proposed a capex of 40 crores over the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: A capacity expansion from 35,000 to 45,000 tons is projected for next year, expected around June.
capex_expansion.quote: So, this has been projected for the next financial year. The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year. From 35,000 to 45,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling.
capex_expansion.quote: So, right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules, and with aluminium and other metals, we make ingots, and then we put them back into the supply chain.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity has reached 35,000 metric tonnes this year.
capex_expansion.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

margins_costs.claim: Margins improved because trade route disruptions created shortages allowing better realizations during the first two months.
margins_costs.quote: Like | said, the disruption in the first two months created a shortage throughout the country and we could take advantage of the shortage. For whatever material we had, we could get much better realizations.

margins_costs.claim: Approximately 85% of inventory is hedged on the exchange.
margins_costs.quote: However, approximately 85% of the inventory which is there is hedged on the exchange.

margins_costs.claim: Silver-bearing and tin-bearing bus bars will give roughly about 10% EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: So, we are, this product will give us roughly about 10%, EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company achieves an EBITDA per kg of around 62 rupees in quarter four.
margins_costs.quote: With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

margins_costs.claim: The company has a pass-through mechanism for copper prices to finished products.
margins_costs.quote: We have a pass-through mechanism of the copper prices to the finished products.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volumes for Q1 FY27 stood at 5,278 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Our sales volumes have dropped, though; they have gone to 5,278 tons, which is a 9.5% decrease from the last quarter and a 6.5% decrease from last year.

orders_capacity.claim: Value-added product share reached 63% this quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

orders_capacity.claim: The company added Crompton Greaves, TMC, and Atlanta in the transformer division and Blue Star, Micron, OBO, and L&T in the data center bus bar division.
orders_capacity.quote: If you take a look, we have added Crompton Greaves, TMC and Atlanta in the transformer division in recent times and in the Al data center bus bar division, we have added Blue Star, Micron, OBO and a few more players, L&T as well.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper sales volume increased by 34% to 24,000 metric tonnes last year.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: The first round of fundraising has been finalized at 52 crores with funds expected in August.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

capital_allocation.claim: The second tranche of fundraising is expected around March after the demerger is completed.
capital_allocation.quote: The second tranche will probably be around March, after the demerger is done, in the standalone copper unit.

capital_allocation.claim: Projected debt in 2030 is estimated between 300 and 350 crores according to long-term projections.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our projection is showing that between 300 and 350 crores will be our debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are looking at a fundraise. We are still not, come up with a final proposal, but we are looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Disruptions in trade routes and material shortages in the first two months caused turnover and volume to come down.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: Shipping lines have been diverted from the Gulf, causing transit delays.
risks_headwinds.quote: And, the material which is coming from the rest of the world, the shipping lines have been diverted because a lot of shipping lines have a transit point in Dubai or somewhere in the Gulf before coming to India. That has got delayed.

management_commitments.claim: The management proposed to execute 40 crores of capex over the next two fiscal years, FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to complete a complete digital transformation of all processes, departments, and reporting over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to gradually increase the share of value-added products to reach 68-69% over a period of 3 or 4 years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we had projected last year that we will slowly keep increasing from the 62% which we had, and reach 68-69% over a period of 3 or 4 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management is planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.
management_commitments.quote: And over here, as mentioned, we are planning to invest 40 crores over the next 2 years on capacities and new ventures.

management_commitments.claim: The company hopes to execute a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores in this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We hope to do it in this financial year, definitely.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to scale up plastic recycling over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: So this is, going to... we're going to scale this up in... over the next year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
